title: data/photo-locations.json
description: Where the photographs were taken, by region. map.html draws a marker per region; js/gallery.js names a tile's place from it and builds the place filter from each region's path; js/palette.js and js/slideshow.js list the regions.

_help.description: How to add a region; read by people, ignored by code.

name.description: The place as captions and the map name it, e.g. "Stirling Castle" or "Ann Arbor, Michigan".

path.description: Where the region sits in the gallery's place filter: [country], [country, town] or [country, town, place in that town], with the state after the country in the United States (["United States", "Michigan", "Ann Arbor"]). A spot outside any town (a loch, a park) stands as its own town.
